karpathy.en: Andrej Karpathy praises the Project Hail Mary film adaptation for faithfully capturing the book's scientific depth and creative alien worldbuilding while maintaining the bromance that makes the story compelling, though noting it leans slightly more into superhero movie pacing than the grand scope of Interstellar or hard sci-fi focus of The Martian.
karpathy.zh: Andrej Karpathy 称赞《Hail Mary 计划》电影版忠实呈现了原著的科学深度和创意十足的外星人设定，同时保留了驱动故事的关键关系，但指出它在节奏上稍微倾向于超级英雄电影的风格，而不是《星际穿越》的宏大或《火星救援》的硬科幻焦点。

swyx.en: Swyx emphasizes that developers should give their designers access to coding agents, as this dramatically increases productivity and creative output—and reveals how much developer constraints were previously limiting designer potential.
swyx.zh: Swyx 强调开发者应该让设计师访问编码 agent，这会显著提升生产力和创意产出——并揭示开发者的限制之前对设计师潜力的制约程度。

joshwoodward.en: Josh Woodward announces a Gemini Android fix that allows users to pause mid-speech without the app cutting them off prematurely, improving the experience of natural conversation flow.
joshwoodward.zh: Josh Woodward 宣布 Gemini Android 修复，允许用户在说话中途暂停而不会被应用打断，改善了自然对话流的体验。

petergyang.en: Peter Yang outlines OpenAI's competitive strategy: leverage ChatGPT's massive user base, improve it for coding and knowledge work, and expand toward personal assistant capabilities like OpenClaw before users migrate to Claude or Gemini.
petergyang.zh: Peter Yang 阐述了 OpenAI 的竞争策略：利用 ChatGPT 庞大的用户基数，为编码和知识工作改进产品，并在用户迁移到 Claude 或 Gemini 之前扩展到个人助手功能。

thenanyu.en: Nan Yu sarcastically comments on Forbes' 30 Under 30 list, suggesting it lacks credibility.
thenanyu.zh: Nan Yu 讽刺评论了《福布斯》30 岁以下精英榜单，暗示其缺乏可信度。

AmandaAskell.en: Amanda Askell humorously suggests getting married again so media outlets have a more recent reference point when discussing her work instead of relying on outdated biographical details.
AmandaAskell.zh: Amanda Askell 幽默地暗示再结一次婚，这样媒体在讨论她的工作时可以有更近期的参考，而不是依赖过时的传记细节。

trq212.en: Thariq announces Claude Code channels, a new feature enabling control of Claude Code sessions through MCPs like Telegram and Discord, allowing direct messaging with Claude Code from mobile devices.
trq212.zh: Thariq 宣布推出 Claude Code channels，这是一项新功能，允许通过 Telegram 和 Discord 等 MCP 控制 Claude Code 会话，支持从移动设备直接与 Claude Code 通信。

amasad.en: Amjad Masad extends warm Eid greetings.
amasad.zh: Amjad Masad 送上温暖的开斋节祝福。

levie.en: Aaron Levie (Box CEO) argues that workers skilled with AI agents will see their compute budgets grow monotonically, extending from engineering to all knowledge work—lawyers drafting documents, marketers running campaigns, sales reps handling leads—as these token-dependent activities scale exponentially.
levie.zh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为掌握 AI agent 的员工的计算预算将单调增长，从工程扩展到所有知识工作——律师起草文件、营销人员运行活动、销售代表处理线索——随着这些 token 依赖活动的指数级扩展。

ryolu_.en: Ryo Lu highlights Composer 2's key strengths: frontier intelligence, fractional cost, and speed in AI development.
ryolu_.zh: Ryo Lu 强调 Composer 2 的关键优势：前沿智能、分数成本和 AI 开发速度。

garrytan.en: Garry Tan (YC President) embedded an easter egg into the YC /office-hours skill.
garrytan.zh: Y Combinator 主席 Garry Tan 在 YC /office-hours skill 中嵌入了一个彩蛋。

mattturck.en: Matt Turck discusses with Benedict Evans OpenAI's focus shifts, ChatGPT's shallow adoption, why better models don't solve real problems, the rise of improvised software, and the role of agents in defensibility—suggesting we're in an AI Desktop Linux moment.
mattturck.zh: Matt Turck 与 Benedict Evans 讨论 OpenAI 的战略转变、ChatGPT 的浅层采用、为什么更好的模型无法解决真正问题、临时软件的崛起以及 agent 在防御性中的作用——暗示我们正处于 AI 桌面 Linux 时刻。

nikunj.en: Nikunj Kothari argues that momentum-driven investing is finally declining, as the ecosystem's focus on unsustainable growth-at-all-costs practices—data manipulation, lack of diligence—will eventually correct.
nikunj.zh: Nikunj Kothari 认为动量驱动的投资最终在衰退，因为生态系统对不可持续的不惜一切代价增长的关注——数据操纵、缺乏尽职调查——最终会纠正。

steipete.en: Peter Steinberger observes that frustration itself has become the product.
steipete.zh: Peter Steinberger 观察到挫折本身已成为产品。

danshipper.en: Dan Shipper published a definitive guide on writing effective prose with AI assistance on Every.
danshipper.zh: Dan Shipper 在 Every 上发布了一份关于使用 AI 协助编写有效文章的权威指南。

Data Driven NYC.en: If you're Sam Alman, you've got a commodity technology. You've got you're competing with people who have giant legacy cash flows. You don't have your own infrastructure, don't really have any differentiation, but you've got massive mind share. So, what do you do? You try and swap that for hard asset...
Data Driven NYC.zh: 如果你是萨姆·阿尔曼，你就拥有了商品技术。你正在与拥有巨额遗产现金流的人竞争。你没有自己的基础设施，没有任何差异化，但你拥有巨大的思想份额。那么，你做什么呢？你尝试将其换成硬资产
